_meta.purpose: Separate marketing / Zigbee2MQTT model names from the real Zigbee identity so enrichment never writes an alias into driver.compose.json productId.
_meta.doctrine: The pairing key is the sacred couple (manufacturerName, modelId) exactly as the device reports it. A vendor model name such as ZG-204ZM is a catalogue label: the hardware reports _TZE200_tyffvoij / TS0601. Writing the label as a productId can never match, and it widens the cartesian claim surface of the driver it sits in.
_meta.relationship: N:N:N - one manufacturerName has many productIds, one (mfr,pid) couple maps to several marketing names, and one marketing name covers several couples.

HOBEIAN.note: HOBEIAN hardware reports Tuya-style manufacturerName prefixes (_TZE200_/_TZE204_/_TZE284_). A literal 'HOBEIAN' manufacturerName entry never matches a real device.
